g.text: Lorenz: factual estimates before and after feedback
All dashed curves are private answers BEFORE seeing anyone else's answer to that question. Titles describe the LATER condition.
The same 144 people answered different questions under each condition; each session contained 12 people.
Lorenz et al. (2011) | doi.org/10.1073/pnas.1008636108 | Released data: Almaatouq et al. (2022) repository
Panel estimate = geometric mean; loss = squared natural-log ratio to truth. This limits domination by extremely large numeric guesses.
Each condition has its own initial 10-report target. Intervals resample whole sessions; a boundary of <=1 does not identify a sub-person panel.
The release retains extreme entries and lacks one control question-group. These are new calculations, not the paper's cleaned effect sizes.
Social k counts reports from existing 12-person sessions, not the number of participants needed to run an experiment.
